title: Oracle: a gateway on the PDB service shows INTERNAL_ERROR, not ORA-65040

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: Oracle Free 23.26.3, PDB service connection

symptom: INGESTION_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ERROR on the PDB service. Direct SQL on the same service fails with ORA-65040 at DBMS_LOGMNR.ADD_LOGFILE; ORA-65040 doesn't appear in the pipeline events.
cause: LogMiner's ADD_LOGFILE isn't allowed from inside a pluggable database (ORA-65040 on direct SQL).
effect: The gateway's message doesn't name the cause.
fix: Connect with the root (CDB) service and name the PDB in source_catalog.
